comments.comment: You are the “thing I needed” for so many of us who have experienced this and needed someone. Thank you for having the courage to share your experience so publicly, normalizing something that is unfortunately more common than expected. You are amazing ❤️🙌
I want to give you and everyone relating to you in the comments a big, warm hug💗 you are all so brave and selfless mamas

I'm so sorry you had to travel for this, no one should have to go trough this extra trouble when going trough something so hard. so does this mean you where also not able to bring back home your still born? Reading this I feel blessed I gave birth close to home and was able to bring back my baby home after terminating my pregnancy for medical reasons. Big hugs too you❤️.

The courage you display in sharing your story and opening a vulnerable wound is inspiring! Hopefully more ppl can do that too and then maybe positive changes for abortion banned states could occur🤞🏻. Thank you for sharing from a friendly 🇨🇦
You didn’t have a “loss”, Hon. You chose not to have a child. That’s not a lost anything
From one tmfr mom to another, I’m so sorry for your loss and that you’re in this club, too. Sending gentle hugs 🤍

I also want to acknowledge you also taking on the emotional toll & pain that comes from speaking about this, and how many people just spew abuse at you and are so evil in the comments. there’s another woman who sees your videos and thinks, thank g-d I’m not alone in this suffering. silent supporter & woman here just saying thank you.
You really didn't make the best choice. I'm so sad about this.
Abortion is a heinous crime and should be punishable by life imprisonment.
